svg.text: Hybrid layout: functional departments for the 13 padded modules (make-to-stock), one-order flow for covers and upholstery (make-to-order)
MAKE-TO-STOCK · 13 padded module types · process layout · batches of 25 · ≤ 85%
MAKE-TO-ORDER · covers and upholstery · one-order flow · saturation ≤ 75% · WIP ≤ 60 orders
13 padded module types (frame + webbing + foam, no cover)
≈ 220 modules ≈ 4 days of use · up to ≈ 350 after the summer build-up
Kanban: reorder point ≈ 13 per type, Q = 25
Decoupling point: the customer order enters here
3 floaters move to the bottleneck of the day
Production lead time: 5 working days (days 2–6). Day 1: order check. Day 7: safety day.
